> **Superseded by #46978 and #46986; closing.** fa4 no longer needs admitting: #46978 removed the speculative backend allow-list in `arg_groups/kv_cache_hook.py`, and #46986 removed the window-draft backend list in `mem_cache/layout/fused_draft.py`. On unmodified main (`76d5b3ce02`, SM90), the configurations measured below fuse their drafts on fa4 under `--enable-unified-memory` and match the default pool on GSM8K (all 1314 questions, greedy, paired by question) and accept length: Inkling-Small multi-layer EAGLE and Qwen3.5-9B NEXTN and DFLASH with CUDA graphs on and off, and MiMo-V2-Flash NEXTN with graphs on. This PR's Inkling fa4 attention-prologue CUDA test also passes on main unchanged.
>
> The original description follows for reference.

---

Stacked on #46378 ([Feat] unified-memory: Fuse sliding-window draft layers on fa3); only the last commit is new here.

## Motivation

Under `--enable-unified-memory`, fa4 already carries the fused draft's translated ids and DSPARK is admitted on it, but EAGLE (and EAGLE3) and DFLASH were still refused at boot on fa4, and a draft with sliding-window layers declined fusion there. fa4 runs on the FlashAttention backend that fa3 uses: the same code builds the page tables, the sliding-window tables and the write locations from the unified pool's translated ids, for the target's verify (whose fa4 graph metadata is already captured from the live mapping) and for the draft's own forwards. Only the attention kernel differs.

## Modifications

- fa4 joins the speculative MHA allow-list (`arg_groups/kv_cache_hook.py`), which admits EAGLE and DFLASH targets and EAGLE drafts and is the fused draft's rail set, and the sliding-window draft backends (`mem_cache/layout/fused_draft.py`). So an Inkling MTP head or a MiMo-V2-Flash MTP head on fa4 fuses into the target's pages instead of being refused at boot.
- An MLA host stays off fa4: its EAGLE target still verifies on the MLA set.

Tests:
- CPU: the spec-gate cases (`test/registered/unit/server_args/test_unified_memory_spec_gate.py`) that admit fa4 for EAGLE and DFLASH, and the placement case that admits an fa4 window draft, fail before this change and pass after; the refused example moves to a backend outside every unified set (torch_native).
- CUDA, `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_inkling_attn_prologue_strided.py`: Inkling's fused fa4 attention prologue (it reads and updates the short-conv state and stores K/V in one kernel) on the unified pool's strided views against contiguous copies, for decode, verify and extend: equal outputs, and the shared buffers change exactly where the contiguous run changed its copies.

## Accuracy Tests

SM90, `--attention-backend fa4`, radix cache, overlap scheduler. GSM8K (all 1314 test questions, 5-shot, greedy, `python -m sglang.test.run_eval`), paired by question between the pools; median accept length from the scheduler logs. The unified-memory servers ran with `SGLANG_DEBUG_POISON_POOL=1`.

| model, speculative setup | CUDA graphs | GSM8K (default / unified) | one pool only right (default / unified), p | accept length (default / unified) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small`, TP 8, multi-layer EAGLE (8 steps, 9 draft tokens, rejection sampling) | off | 0.814 / 0.831 | 92 / 114, p = 0.14 | 3.44 / 3.42 |
| same | on | 0.825 / 0.830 | 81 / 88, p = 0.65 | 3.42 / 3.43 |
| `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B`, TP 1, NEXTN (3 steps, 4 draft tokens) | off | 0.895 / 0.896 | 8 / 9, p = 1.00 | 3.52 / 3.51 |
| same | on | 0.893 / 0.894 | 6 / 7, p = 1.00 | 3.51 / 3.52 |
| `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B`, TP 1, DFLASH (`z-lab/Qwen3.5-9B-DFlash`, 16 draft tokens) | off | 0.896 / 0.893 | 5 / 2, p = 0.45 | 6.35 / 6.36 |
| same | on | 0.896 / 0.898 | 4 / 7, p = 0.55 | 6.36 / 6.38 |
| `XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash`, TP 4, NEXTN (3 steps, 4 draft tokens) | on | 0.839 / 0.833 | - | 2.71 / 2.71 |

Inkling-Small used `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-draft-model-path thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small --enable-multi-layer-eagle --speculative-num-steps 8 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 9 --speculative-use-rejection-sampling`. The DFLASH measurements here use TP 1; attention-DP combinations were not evaluated.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This PR admits a configuration; it does not change kernels. For reference, with #46376 applied, Inkling-Small's multi-layer EAGLE draft on fa4 decodes about 10% slower per step on the unified pool than on the default pool at equal batch size (100 requests of 512 input / 4096 output tokens at concurrency 128, and 192 requests sharing a 4096-token prefix + 128 tokens, 2048 output tokens, concurrency 192). On the unified pool that draft runs its steps as per-step CUDA graphs that rebuild draft-extend metadata eagerly, where the default pool captures one combined graph. A follow-up PR in this series, "[Perf] unified-memory: Stage a fused draft's draft-extend metadata once per draft cycle", lets the unified pool take the combined graph too and brings the gap to about 1-2%.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+# Copyright 2023-2026 SGLang Team
+# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#

+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+# ==============================================================================
+"""The fused Inkling attention prologue on the unified pool's views.
+
+Under --enable-unified-memory every per-layer conv cache and KV buffer is a
+strided view whose slot stride is one whole token-major entry. Each prologue
+(decode, target verify, extend) must produce what it produces on contiguous
+copies of the same values, and write only its own rows of the shared buffers.
+
+    python -m pytest test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_inkling_attn_prologue_strided.py -v
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.inkling_attn_prologue import (
+    inkling_attn_prologue_decode,
+    inkling_attn_prologue_extend,
+    inkling_attn_prologue_verify,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.layout.token_major import (
+    build_dense_views,
+    build_mamba_entry_views,
+    mamba_entry_bytes,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_memory_pool import MHASubPoolSpec
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=40, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+HEAD = 128
+W = 4
+DQ, DKV = 2048, 256
+ROW = DQ + 2 * DKV + 64  # packed qkvr row with an r tail
+EPS = 1e-6
+LAYERS = 3
+LAYER = 1  # a middle layer, so every entry holds rows on both sides of it
+CONV_SLOTS = 16
+KV_SLOTS = 64
+# Inkling's six conv streams (k/v full, k/v local, attn, mlp), channel-last.
+CONV_SHAPES = [(W - 1, DKV)] * 2 + [(W - 1, HEAD)] * 2 + [(W - 1, 512)] * 2
+KV_SPEC = MHASubPoolSpec(
+    name="full",
+    layer_num=LAYERS,
+    grow_direction="up",
+    head_num=DKV // HEAD,
+    head_dim=HEAD,
+    store_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+)
+
+
+def _conv_kwargs():
+    return dict(
+        layer_num=LAYERS,
+        conv_state_shapes=CONV_SHAPES,
+        conv_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        temporal_state_shape=(0, 0, 0),
+        temporal_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+
+
+def _raw(nbytes):
+    raw = torch.empty(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    raw.view(torch.bfloat16).normal_()
+    return raw
+
+
+def _conv_views(raw):
+    views, _ = build_mamba_entry_views(raw, max_slots=CONV_SLOTS, **_conv_kwargs())
+    return views[0][LAYER], views[1][LAYER]
+
+
+def _kv_views(raw):
+    return tuple(
+        build_dense_views(
+            raw, layout=KV_SPEC.layout(), part_name=part, num_slots=KV_SLOTS
+        )[LAYER]
+        for part in ("k", "v")
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_matches_contiguous(test, call):
+    """Run ``call(k_cache, v_cache, k_buf, v_buf)`` on the unified views and on
+    contiguous copies: equal outputs, and the shared buffers changed exactly
+    where the contiguous run changed its copies."""
+    conv_raw = _raw(CONV_SLOTS * mamba_entry_bytes(**_conv_kwargs()))
+    kv_raw = _raw(KV_SLOTS * KV_SPEC.entry_bytes())
+    want_conv, want_kv = conv_raw.clone(), kv_raw.clone()
+    views = _conv_views(conv_raw) + _kv_views(kv_raw)
+    test.assertGreater(views[0].stride(0), (W - 1) * DKV)
+    test.assertGreater(views[2].stride(0), DKV)
+    copies = [v.clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format) for v in views]
+
+    got = call(*views)
+    want = call(*copies)
+    for a, b in zip(got, want):
+        test.assertTrue(torch.equal(a, b))
+    for view, copy in zip(_conv_views(want_conv) + _kv_views(want_kv), copies):
+        view.copy_(copy)
+    test.assertTrue(torch.equal(conv_raw, want_conv))
+    test.assertTrue(torch.equal(kv_raw, want_kv))
+
+
+def _weights():
+    kw = torch.randn(DKV, W, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3
+    vw = torch.randn(DKV, W, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3
+    qg = torch.randn(HEAD, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    kg = torch.randn(HEAD, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    return dict(k_weight=kw, v_weight=vw, q_gamma=qg, k_gamma=kg, eps=EPS)
+
+
+def _cuda(values, dtype):
+    return torch.tensor(values, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+
+
+def _qkv_offsets():
+    return dict(q_off=0, k_off=DQ, v_off=DQ + DKV, dq=DQ, dkv=DKV)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "needs CUDA")
+class TestInklingAttnPrologueStrided(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    def test_decode(self):
+        qkvr = torch.randn(6, ROW, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        args = dict(
+            qkvr=qkvr,
+            cache_indices=_cuda([3, 7, -1, 11, 2, 9], torch.int32),
+            cache_mask=_cuda([1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1], torch.bool),
+            track_mask=_cuda([1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0], torch.bool),
+            track_indices=_cuda([13, 0, 0, 14, 0, 0], torch.int64),
+            loc=_cuda([5, 40, 17, 63, 1, 22], torch.int64),
+            **_weights(),
+            **_qkv_offsets(),
+        )
+
+        def call(k_cache, v_cache, k_buf, v_buf):
+            return inkling_attn_prologue_decode(
+                k_cache=k_cache, v_cache=v_cache, k_buf=k_buf, v_buf=v_buf, **args
+            )[:3]
+
+        _assert_matches_contiguous(self, call)
+
+    def test_verify(self):
+        bs, draft_token_num = 3, 4
+        num_tokens = bs * draft_token_num
+        loc = torch.randperm(KV_SLOTS, device="cuda")[:num_tokens]
+        loc[5] = -1  # a full->swa translation sentinel: no store
+        args = dict(
+            qkvr=torch.randn(num_tokens, ROW, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+            cache_indices=_cuda([4, -1, 10], torch.int32),
+            cache_mask=_cuda([1, 1, 0], torch.bool),
+            loc=loc,
+            draft_token_num=draft_token_num,
+            **_weights(),
+            **_qkv_offsets(),
+        )
+
+        def call(k_cache, v_cache, k_buf, v_buf):
+            inter = [
+                torch.zeros(
+                    bs, draft_token_num, W - 1, DKV, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+                for _ in range(2)
+            ]
+            out = inkling_attn_prologue_verify(
+                k_cache=k_cache,
+                v_cache=v_cache,
+                k_inter=inter[0],
+                v_inter=inter[1],
+                k_buf=k_buf,
+                v_buf=v_buf,
+                **args,
+            )
+            return list(out[:3]) + inter
+
+        _assert_matches_contiguous(self, call)
+
+    def test_extend(self):
+        # Lengths 1 and 2 are shorter than the conv window: their cache update
+        # shifts in old rows (with history) or zeros (without).
+        lens = _cuda([5, 1, 9, 2], torch.int64)
+        cu = torch.nn.functional.pad(torch.cumsum(lens, 0), (1, 0))
+        num_tokens = int(cu[-1])
+        has_initial_state = _cuda([1, 1, 0, 0], torch.bool)
+        cache_indices = _cuda([6, 12, -1, 1], torch.int32)
+        track_rows = (
+            cu[1:, None] - (W - 1) + torch.arange(W - 1, device="cuda")
+        ).clamp(min=0)
+        args = dict(
+            qkvr=torch.randn(num_tokens, ROW, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+            cache_indices=cache_indices,
+            cache_mask=has_initial_state & (cache_indices != -1),
